name: Axio Analyst
author: Kian (Zenco)
description: Read-only AI analysis with bounded context.
longdescription: Provides native Chat and Settings views with exact context preview, opt-in callers, callees, selections, strings, imports, and types, evidence navigation, optional local transcripts, provider comparison, usage metadata, sanitized Markdown, streaming progress, and supervised Claude Code, Codex, and Ollama Cloud harnesses. Does not modify the database.
